summary.name: getapps.cafe
summary.one_liner: A subscription service that unlocks a curated set of native macOS and Windows desktop apps for one monthly or yearly plan.
use_cases: replace Microsoft Word for offline .docx editing
compress PNG, JPEG or WebP images
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a subscription that bundles about 128 hand-picked, native macOS and Windows desktop apps, with a 7-day free trial. Named apps include DocCafe (native .docx editor that replaces Word), SheetCafe (.xlsx, .xls and .csv editor with formulas, charts and pivot tables), PDFCafe (offline PDF editor), CreamShot X (screen capture with OCR), ClipBrew (clipboard history) and DripCleaner (junk file cleanup). Several free apps are also listed, including a 3D chess game, a file transfer tool and an image compressor. The page says the plan covers one device (Solo Cup) or up to five (Family Roast).
notable: One subscription covers about 128 curated native apps, with some free apps available without an account
Includes DocCafe (.docx) and SheetCafe (.xlsx) editors that work offline
Per-device licence slots; devices can be removed from the account to free a slot
caveats: Paid subscription after a 7-day free trial that requires a card
Only macOS and Windows are supported
Pricing figures on the page are inconsistent: $23.88 billed yearly for Solo Cup versus $3.99/month in the description
